recall.question: What is this file?
recall.answer: A placement test (not a grade) for ML foundations. Attempt closed-book, 20 minutes. Answers in keys-01.md.

recall.question: D01: Name the features and the target.
recall.answer: Features: age, blood pressure, cholesterol. Target: heart attack in 10 years.

keyTerms.definition: The model memorized the training set and does not generalize.

recall.question: D02: Name the failure in one sentence.
recall.answer: Overfitting: the model memorized the training set and does not generalize.

keyTerms.definition: A straight line fit to curving data; training error stays high.
Use a model family that can bend, e.g. add squared features.

recall.question: D03: Name the failure and state one fix.
recall.answer: Underfitting (high bias). Fix: use a model family that can bend, for example add squared features.

keyTerms.definition: To score well on data the model has not seen.

recall.question: D04: What does it mean for a model to generalize?
recall.answer: To generalize is to score well on data the model has not seen.

keyTerms.definition: Tuned 40 settings on the test set.

recall.question: D05: Whose test score can you trust, and why?
recall.answer: Student B. Student A contaminated the test set by tuning on it, so the score measures tuning effort, not future performance.

keyTerms.definition: A useless model scores 95% because the class balance is 95 to 5.

recall.question: D06: What is the accuracy, and is it a good metric?
recall.answer: 95 percent accuracy. It is a poor metric: a useless model scores 95 percent because the class balance is 95 to 5. Use precision and recall, or a balanced metric.

recall.question: D07: Write the two shapes.
recall.answer: x has shape (4,). The design matrix has shape (200, 4).

keyTerms.definition: Flat almost everywhere; the gradient is zero wherever it exists.

recall.question: D08: Why is the 0/1 loss a poor training signal?
recall.answer: The 0/1 loss is flat almost everywhere, so its gradient is zero wherever it exists. Gradient methods get no direction to move.
